chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to throw the pebbles at the Jamarat while walking.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to stone the Jamarat while riding or walking during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahar highlights the Prophetic precedent (Sunnah) of performing the stoning of the Jamarat on foot, which serves as a primary evidence for the permissibility of this method in Shia jurisprudence. It underscores the flexibility within the ritual, contrasting with the practice of riding, and reflects the practical adaptability of the Prophet's actions during Hajj.
